basis: i_prefetch with identical sequencer and descriptor/HASH bubble improvements. No ROM edit in these files; may be combined with independently validated i_rom candidate.

physical_cut.fast_reader: narrow_register_read has no FORS_TARGET or DIGIT data source; those selectors return default0 on that function.
physical_cut.slow_capture_reader: narrow_read adds the derived FORS_TARGET/DIGIT lookups only for snapshotting both21bit operand registers.
physical_cut.execute_data: CONTROL_OPERANDS uses registered operands; every other execution state uses only narrow_register_read.
physical_cut.pipeline: No fast data mux input contains actual FORS/DIGIT derived data. This physically separates extraction/mux delay from ALU/legality/writeback; no timing exceptions.
physical_cut.retirement: Pure slow controls signal completion in CONTROL_OPERANDS execution edge, suppress delayed control_complete pulse to avoid retiring a following instruction spuriously. Extraonecycle per slow instruction versus fast retirement.
physical_cut.branch_condition: Resolved current staged operands feed sequencer on same execution/retirement edge, including correctly and incorrectly predicted branches.
physical_cut.load_address: Slow LOAD registers readaddress in CONTROL_OPERANDS before CONTROL_LOAD consumes RAM; fast LOAD retains FETCH address setup.
physical_cut.store_address: Accepted STORE registers8bit control_store_slot before CONTROL_STORE writesRAM, including slow selectors; rejected addresses never enter STORE.

error_semantics: Original ISA/encoding/read-only/overflow and RAM108+ rejection checks retained.
Read stages can update only internal operand/address registers; invalid stores must not assert endpoint_write.
Implicit/autonomous CHAIN/TREE never introduced; one explicitHASH authorizes each request as before.
No source/digest lifetime merging; original result/register bank boundaries retained.

checks: FORS EQ/NE taken and untaken redirects
FORS RAM slot4 STORE/LOAD plus108 rejection
DIGIT branch and RAM slot1 STORE/LOAD

measurement_status: No synthesis/route/performance measurements launched by this agent; root owns frozen candidate validation and100MHz implementation.
